prompt: Analyze frequently purchased product combinations to identify common bundles in the sales data. Compare how these co-purchase patterns vary across store locations and seasonal time periods.
title: Co-Purchase Bundle Analysis
summary: Analyze frequently purchased product combinations to identify common bundles in the sales data. Compare how these co-purchase patterns vary across store locations and seasonal time periods.
executed_sql_queries:
WITH order_products AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT oi.order_id, p.product_name
  FROM retail.order_items oi
  JOIN retail.products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
), pair_counts AS (
  SELECT
    LEAST(op1.product_name, op2.product_name) AS product_1,
    GREATEST(op1.product_name, op2.product_name) AS product_2,
    COUNT(DISTINCT op1.order_id) AS co_purchase_count
  FROM order_products op1
  JOIN order_products op2
    ON op1.order_id = op2.order_id
   AND op1.product_name < op2.product_name
  GROUP BY 1, 2
), total_orders AS (
  SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS total_order_count
  FROM retail.orders
)
SELECT
  pc.product_1,
  pc.product_2,
  pc.co_purchase_count,
  ROUND(100.0 * pc.co_purchase_count / t.total_order_count, 2) AS order_share,
  DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY pc.co_purchase_count DESC, pc.product_1, pc.product_2) AS bundle_rank
FROM pair_counts pc
CROSS JOIN total_orders t
ORDER BY bundle_rank, pc.product_1, pc.product_2
LIMIT 100

WITH order_items_dedup AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        o.order_id,
        EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_date)::int AS order_year,
        oi.product_id,
        p.product_name
    FROM retail.orders o
    JOIN retail.order_items oi
        ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
    JOIN retail.products p
        ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
    WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_date)::int BETWEEN 2020 AND 2023
), order_pairs AS (
    SELECT
        a.order_id,
        a.order_year,
        CASE WHEN a.product_name < b.product_name THEN a.product_name ELSE b.product_name END AS product_1,
        CASE WHEN a.product_name < b.product_name THEN b.product_name ELSE a.product_name END AS product_2
    FROM order_items_dedup a
    JOIN order_items_dedup b
        ON a.order_id = b.order_id
       AND a.product_id < b.product_id
), pair_counts AS (
    SELECT
        order_year,
        product_1 || ' + ' || product_2 AS product_combination,
        COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS seasonal_bundle_count,
        COUNT(DISTINCT order_id)::numeric / SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT order_id)) OVER (PARTITION BY order_year) AS seasonal_order_share,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY order_year ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) DESC, product_1, product_2) AS bundle_rank
    FROM order_pairs
    GROUP BY order_year, product_1, product_2
)
SELECT
    order_year,
    product_combination,
    seasonal_bundle_count,
    ROUND(seasonal_order_share, 6) AS seasonal_order_share,
    bundle_rank
FROM pair_counts
WHERE bundle_rank <= 10
ORDER BY order_year, bundle_rank;
SELECT store_id, store_name, CASE WHEN store_name IS NULL THEN 'UNKNOWN' ELSE store_name END AS store_location_key FROM retail.stores ORDER BY store_id

WITH counts AS ( SELECT 'overall'::text AS period, COUNT(*)::bigint AS total_orders, 0 AS sort_key FROM retail.orders UNION ALL SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM order_date)::text AS period, COUNT(*)::bigint AS total_orders, 1 AS sort_key FROM retail.orders GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM order_date) ) SELECT period, total_orders FROM counts ORDER BY sort_key, period
